name: pulsefx
description: Pulse FX monorepo: API (Node.js/TypeScript) + web (React/TypeScript) + tipos compartilhados.

scripts.predev: docker compose up -d --wait postgres && npm run migrate:up
scripts.migrate: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; npm run migrate -w apps/api'
scripts.migrate:up: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; npm run migrate:up -w apps/api'
